page: OVHcloud l4-90 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance engineered for AI inference, graphics processing, and compute workloads requiring dedicated CPU power. Hosted on the KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 9454 processor delivering 22 dedicated physical cores and 22 threads clocked at 2.75 GHz. It includes advanced x86_64 instruction extensions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. System memory totals 90 GB of RAM, equating to approximately 4.09 GB per core, backed by 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and an 8 Gbps baseline network interface. Public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by a single NVIDIA L4 GPU built on the Ada Lovelace architecture, featuring 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. In synthetic compute benchmarks, the server delivers top-tier single-core CPU throughput in stress-ng tests and strong multi-core execution. The GPU architecture provides high-efficiency inference capability, achieving top-decile token generation and prompt processing rates on 135M and 7B parameter language models. For larger models such as 70B parameter architectures, prompt processing remains strong, though memory limitations require quantization or multi-node distribution for text generation.

The configuration provides balanced resource density by pairing dedicated, non-hyperthreaded EPYC cores with moderate memory and specialized tensor acceleration. Because CPU threads map one-to-one with physical cores, multi-threaded tasks avoid contention, demonstrated by strong bzip3 multi-threaded decompression results. However, network capacity is capped at an 8 Gbps baseline, and local scratch space is restricted to 400 GB, making external block or object storage necessary for large datasets.

OVHcloud l4-90 is suited for real-time machine learning inference, computer vision, video transcoding, and small-to-medium parameter model fine-tuning. It also supports engineering simulation and data processing pipelines that require predictable dedicated x86 execution alongside hardware-accelerated matrix operations.
description: OVHcloud l4-90 is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance designed for machine learning inference and parallel compute workloads. Built on the KVM hypervisor, it features 22 dedicated physical cores from an AMD EPYC 9454 processor at 2.75 GHz, offering 1:1 thread-to-core mapping and AVX-512 extensions. The server is equipped with 90 GB of system memory, a 400 GB NVMe SSD, an 8 Gbps baseline network link, and a single NVIDIA L4 GPU with 24 GB of Ada Lovelace VRAM. In performance evaluations, the system achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core execution and language model inference on models up to 7B parameters. The hardware profile provides dedicated compute stability without virtual CPU oversubscription, though high-capacity storage must be provisioned externally due to the 400 GB local drive limit. It is well matched for real-time model serving, video rendering pipelines, and data processing tasks requiring dedicated compute coupled with GPU acceleration.
